observed_fact.strict_conclusion: The physical low-level interface has a scoring/transport witness, while the fresh-high sparse path was reward-starved and the frozen V55 analytic teacher was not a scoring witness. This supports one high-only reward-support canary; it does not prove the shaped policy will solve the task or exclude a later ball-conditioned 50 Hz adapter.

If the first 25600 on-policy transitions do not contain finite, reconstructible, above-noise positive progress on both requested goal sides and negative progress globally, stop before PPO. If support exists, the unchanged V54 budget can test whether this credit improves strict fixed goals.

This is total for ball states outside that box, 1-Lipschitz and reflection symmetric.

engineering_repair_r2.observed_fact: R1 removed the exact periodic-faulthandler crash signature and completed eight of twelve bounded PPO iterations, with 160 of 240 optimizer steps durably reported. During the ninth rollout, step called _reset_idx for terminal slots and raised RuntimeError: ContactSensor history did not reset. This was an engineering failure before final training or fixed evaluation, not a behavioral result; no partial R1 checkpoint is a continuation parent.
engineering_repair_r2.root_cause: IsaacLab ContactSensor.reset did clear the selected cached force buffers, but SensorBase.reset also marked those slots outdated. The immediate reset-time check then accessed the public ContactSensor.data property before another physics step. That lazy property refreshed from the still-current previous-episode PhysX contact view and wrote the old terminal contact back into the newly cleared history. The verifier read itself therefore recreated the nonzero history that it reported as a reset failure.
engineering_repair_r2.ball_z_sibling_risk: The same reset boundary also copied each selected ball's live pre-reset world z into its next reset pose. A terminal airborne or displaced z could therefore leak across episodes even though reset x/y, velocity and serial changed. This sibling risk was found statically in the failed path; it is not claimed as the observed cause of job 17940941, but it must be closed by the same atomic reset repair and physical probe rather than deferred to another training attempt.
engineering_repair_r2.falsifiable_hypothesis: An atomic reset boundary that installs the canonical reset pose including ball z, resets every contact sensor consumed by V56 after the pose writes, verifies only cached reset state without triggering lazy data refresh, and permits the first public force read only after normal physics should survive a real nonzero-contact subset reset without cross-episode force or height leakage.
engineering_repair_r2.smallest_isolated_change: Repair only the V56 reset transaction and add its bounded pre-training engineering probe. Preserve the declared V14 x/y/yaw sampling distribution while restoring canonical ball z/quaternion/velocity; do not change task observations, command mapping, reward, terminal thresholds or precedence, recurrent policy, PPO configuration, optimizer budget, fixed cases, scientific gates or decision tokens.

pre_training_probe_gate.position: One bounded child in the same Slurm transaction after exact source/task/low checks and before initial fixed evaluation, fresh high-policy construction or PPO optimizer construction.
pre_training_probe_gate.pass: The probe must first establish an actual nonzero robot-ball PhysX contact, then reset selected live slots through the repaired _reset_idx path. Selected ball/base cached current and history buffers must be cleared without any reset-time public ContactSensor.data read, unselected slots must remain unchanged, ball z and the complete live reset pose must match the canonical new sample, sensor refresh must occur only after the next normal physics step, and no previous-episode ball contact may survive that refresh. A durable summary and PASS guard must bind the exact source, task and low identities.
pre_training_probe_gate.fail: Any missing physical-contact precondition, cached reset mismatch, lazy pre-physics read, ball-z inheritance, selected/unselected corruption, post-physics refresh failure or missing durable receipt is an engineering RC-nonzero stop before evaluation, fresh high PPO or checkpoint creation. Do not interpret it behaviorally and do not start the full canary.

outcome_actions.probe_reject: Preserve the bounded probe evidence and repair the reset hypothesis before another full transaction; do not consume a training budget.

outcome_actions.probe_pass_then_other_engineering_failur: Preserve the one-job evidence and diagnose the new failure read-only before changing another mechanism.
outcome_actions.closed_terminal_branch: Interpret only the original V56 scientific gates after all twelve iterations, 240 optimizer steps when authorized by reward support, fresh final fixed evaluation and original independent guards close. R2 itself adds no behavioral authorization.

pre_training_probe_gate.position: The repaired probe remains one bounded fresh child in the same Slurm transaction after exact source/task/low checks and before initial fixed evaluation, fresh high-policy construction or PPO optimizer construction.
pre_training_probe_gate.physical_contact_lane: For selected slots, place the ball center at a predeclared live calf-body center, zero ball velocity, and advance only bounded raw physics ticks. On one and the same tick and calf/filter index, every accepted slot must have robot_ball_contact.force_matrix_w norm >= 1 N and contact_forces.net_forces_w norm >= 1 N. Current-frame, per-slot values are authoritative; history maxima, different ticks, different robot bodies, ball displacement and millinewton noise cannot satisfy the gate. After the witnessed tick, call the real _reset_idx immediately without overwriting the selected physical force caches with sentinels.
pre_training_probe_gate.immediate_cache_and_raw_view_lane: Before any public ContactSensor.data access, require the selected private current/history/timer caches to be exactly cleared, lifecycle metadata reset and marked outdated, unselected slots bit-exact, and the complete selected ball root state to equal canonical default state plus the new sampled XY. Snapshot those private caches, query the raw PhysX contact views, then snapshot again and require the two private snapshots to be bit-exact. Raw-view force values are recorded for attribution only: either a stale nonzero prior-frame view or an already-cleared view is legal and neither value determines PASS.
pre_training_probe_gate.one_tick_lane: With no intervening public sensor read, advance exactly one raw physics tick and only then access the public sensor data. Require finite current data, fresh metadata with timestamps advanced by exactly one physics dt, and exact-zero history tails after index zero for both the four-frame ball history and three-frame robot history. A four-tick low_env.step cannot prove this boundary because it can roll an illicit pre-physics sample completely out of both histories.
pre_training_probe_gate.sentinel_lane: Separately from the real-contact lane, inject distinct per-field and per-slot sentinels and exercise both vectorized partial and full resets. Require selected exact clearing, unselected exact preservation, metadata reset and complete canonical ball root state. This lane provides exhaustive cache coverage but cannot substitute for the physical-contact lane.
pre_training_probe_gate.production_integration_lane: After the one-tick causal check, use a separate fresh-reset lane for one normal frozen-low low_env.step. This checks production integration, finiteness and sensor freshness only; its four internal physics ticks are not first-refresh evidence.
pre_training_probe_gate.fail: Any missing same-tick same-calf force witness, cache mutation caused by the raw-view query, selected clear failure, unselected mutation, canonical-state mismatch, one-tick history leak, production integration failure or missing durable trace is an engineering RC-nonzero stop with PPO_OPTIMIZER_STEPS=0 before evaluation, policy construction, optimizer construction or training.
pre_training_probe_gate.pass: Only a durable independently checked PASS for every lane authorizes the same job to start the unchanged initial fixed evaluation and a completely fresh V56 transaction. Probe integrity alone is not behavioral evidence and never authorizes long training.

outcome_actions.probe_reject: Preserve the per-tick force/body/filter, private-cache, raw-view and first-refresh trace and stop with zero PPO steps. Diagnose that exact evidence; do not lower the contact threshold or start a separate training job.
outcome_actions.probe_pass: Proceed only within the same evidence-closed job through the unchanged initial evaluation, reward-support gate, fresh bounded PPO when supported, final evaluation and terminal guards.
outcome_actions.partial_reuse_forbidden: Never load, continue, score as a candidate, or otherwise reuse a partial checkpoint from any failed V56 transaction. Every authorized training attempt starts from the declared fresh high initialization and exact frozen low.

engineering_repair_r4.observed_fact: R3 job 17944428 stopped after about 41 seconds while constructing and checking the live contact-contract receipt, before any calf contact trial. The receipt showed that accepted_body_names and live_body_names were the exact accepted 19-name ordered array, while base_contact_body_names contained the same 19 unique names in a different deterministic grouped order. The positional-order assertion therefore rejected a valid live ContactSensor enumeration. No call to _reset_idx occurred, no high policy or optimizer was constructed and PPO optimizer steps remained zero.
engineering_repair_r4.strict_scope: Job 17944428 falsified only the probe's assumption that articulation bodies, ball-side exact filters and the robot-side ContactSensor share one positional index. It did not exercise or falsify calf contact acquisition, the R2 atomic reset implementation, selected or unselected cache clearing, canonical ball state, the one-tick refresh lane, PPO or task behavior.
engineering_repair_r4.root_cause: The R3 probe collapsed three distinct live namespaces into one integer: env.robot.body_names for the calf pose, the accepted robot_ball_contact filter order for the ball-side pair force, and env.base_contact.body_names for the robot-side net force. Job 16315309 qualified the articulation-name to exact ball-filter mapping; it neither asserted nor needed the independently enumerated base ContactSensor body order. The 75 static tests used synthetic arrays copied from the accepted contract, so they proved fail-closed positional logic but could not discover the live simulator's different base-sensor ordering.
engineering_repair_r4.falsifiable_hypothesis: If each calf is joined by name across the three independently indexed interfaces, then the already-qualified physical fixture can be evaluated without weakening identity or force evidence. For every candidate, resolve and record a robot_body_index from live_body_names, a ball_filter_index from accepted_body_names and a base_sensor_body_index from base_contact_body_names; use each index only with its own tensor. A same-tick >=1 N witness in both sensors must still name the same calf in every selected slot.
engineering_repair_r4.smallest_isolated_change: Change only the bounded probe, its v2 evidence/checker and closure tests to replace positional equality with an exact, unique, name-based three-index join. Keep accepted_body_names and live_body_names exactly ordered as qualified; require base_contact_body_names to be a duplicate-free permutation of the same exact 19-name set. Do not alter the production environment, reset implementation, contract, reward, observation, action, terminal logic, PPO, fixed evaluator, 1 N threshold, raw-physics contact construction or any behavioral decision.
